_doc: Registry of frontier-model system cards consumed into gzkit doctrine (chore: frontier-model-card-currency). One entry per card. status: current (latest for its vendor tier, consumed), unconsumed (published, not yet evaluated against doctrine), superseded (a newer card for the same tier exists; rules sourced SOLELY to it must be re-sourced or retired). consumed_commits are the doctrine-refresh commits; doctrine_surfaces are the files whose citations trace to the card. The chore compares this registry against the vendor publication hubs and reports drift — it never auto-consumes a card.

vendor_hubs.anthropic: https://www.anthropic.com/news (system card announcements; PDFs linked per release)
